sentence: This project provides genomic sequencing, transcriptomic sequencing and bioinformatics analysis that help investigators study the biology of cancer.
This project builds deep learning models that use genomic and clinical data to predict when glioma, lung adenocarcinoma and breast cancer return.
This project develops a plan to evaluate whether a faculty hiring program improves institutional culture and research success.
This project tests web-based cognitive training meant to improve executive control in healthy older adults.
This project builds a nanoparticle system that helps head and neck cancers overcome resistance to immunotherapy.
This project studies how type III immune systems in prokaryotes acquire spacers.
This project studies how a small molecule called Metformin might restore a protective antioxidant response in the aging eye lens.
This project uses genetic evaluation to find the genetic causes of mosaic disorders, which are patterned skin conditions.
This project studies how aging and regeneration change cell types and their mRNA expression in planarians.
This project develops an on-demand vaginal device that lets women prevent unintended pregnancy without hormones.
This project uses large collections of real-world data to study how Alzheimer's disease risk and progression differ in sexual minority populations.
This project uses geometric criteria from computed tomography angiography imaging to judge aortic stability in type B aortic dissection.
This project tests whether brain responses to social acceptance and self-referential processing predict personality impairment in youth over two years.
This project tries to find the molecular pathways and epigenetic drivers that cause metastasis in breast cancer.
This project provides genomics services, such as preparing sequencing libraries and spatial transcriptomics, to support cancer research.
This project studies how beneficial gut bacteria interact with the host through the gut-brain axis in hypertension.
This project tries to find out how a compound that binds a protein turns on a stress response that kills leukemia cells.
This project tests virtual reality technology to reduce stress and build resilience in Black women, who show higher cardiovascular disease risk markers.
This project combines research support personnel into one group that runs and maintains laboratory facilities and equipment.
This project studies how cells make proteins and how to overcome harmful mutations that interrupt protein synthesis.
